'''Wyll Kander''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] of the [[Galactic War]] he was posted at the [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]].
